_about: John Alexander Stewart (1846-1933), White's Professor of Moral Philosophy at Oxford. Raw IA OCR: Plato's Doctrine of Ideas (Oxford: Clarendon Press, 1909), clean 0.83. Wanted: The Myths of Plato (1905) and Notes on the Nicomachean Ethics (1892, 2 vols.); every scan tried is Greek-heavy and falls below the 0.78 OCR gate (0.76-0.78 and 0.61). Not Dugald Stewart (shelf dugald-stewart). US public domain. No uids minted. Also raw IA: Notes on the Nicomachean Ethics of Aristotle (Clarendon Press, 2 vols., 1892), the English commentary on the Greek, kept per Adam's 2026-10-23 ruling; The Myths of Plato, translated with introduction and essays (Macmillan, 1905); The English Manuscripts of the Nicomachean Ethics (Anecdota Oxoniensia, 1882).
